title: a based literal above INT64_MAX is rejected
purpose: Invalid source is rejected before execution.

rejection.justification: The guide requires a language diagnostic for unrepresentable literals without fixing lexer vs analysis stage.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: bitwise guide: based literals are nonnegative and limited to INT64_MAX (0x8000000000000000 = 2^63).
